command:
mkdir -p /opt/inventory && cat > /opt/inventory/app.py <<'PYEOF'
import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "WH-1001", "name": "Wireless Mouse", "qty": 42, "location": "A1"},
    {"sku": "WH-1002", "name": "USB-C Hub", "qty": 17, "location": "A2"},
    {"sku": "WH-1003", "name": "Mechanical Keyboard", "qty": 8, "location": "B1"},
]

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path in ("/", "/inventory"):
            body = json.dumps({"inventory": INVENTORY}, indent=2).encode()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        elif self.path == "/healthz":
            body = b"ok\n"
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8181), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
